governance.note: Byte-faithful re-solve of the run143 keeper recipe (results/calibration/ercot_dam_2023as_netload; reproduce driver scripts/probes/_keeper_2023as_run.py, storage-AS-from-year 2025, load-RRS-from-year 2023, ST_GAS committed delta restored to 0.0, ECRS off). The ONLY changed input is the regenerated ERCOT outage CSVs (data/raw/campd-outages.csv + campd-unit-outages.csv), now on the LOCAL (seasonal) net-load band: high_load_mask compares each hour to a centered rolling +/-30-day net-load percentile instead of the single annual percentile (commit 152bb99). The outage filter keys on EXOGENOUS net load (EIA-930 demand - wind - solar), never on the LMP. Active levers all trace to measured inputs: CAMPD unit/facility outage windows (local-band-filtered), measured 2023 storage-AS (build_ercot_as_by_restype_from_60day.py) + load-RRS-UFR credit (build_ercot_as_2023.py, DAMASAGG-reconciled), EIA-860 BTM CHP host steam pulled out of the LP (btm.parquet), per-plant F923 monthly delivered gas, published NP6-576-ER ORDC params. No adder/haircut/sigmoid was tuned to the price or volume residual; no unit pinned to its observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled so the model output lands on actuals.

exceptions.reason: ~1.0-1.2 TWh/yr of CT_PEAKER benchmark sits in non-CEMS small peakers (Ector County, Permian Basin, Pearsall) with no hourly CEMS for the deployment overlay to key off and no merit-order path in an energy-only LP. Documented structural miss (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md). ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION, not a merit-order defect.

Same non-CEMS small-peaker wedge as 2023; the energy-only LP cannot dispatch out-of-merit AS/RUC peaker energy and there is no defensible forward way to add it. Documented structural miss (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md). ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION.
Same non-CEMS small-peaker wedge; energy-only LP merit-order cannot reach it. ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md).

The residual CC_REGULAR over-run is the documented NODAL-congestion residual: 94% of SCED binding-constraint rent is on <200 kV local pockets that a zonal LP cannot resolve, so the displaced low-merit energy lands on CC rather than being constrained off. Measured NO-GO for finer-zone topology (2026-06-17 nodal-pockets session: no unmodelled aggregate GTC isolates the North over-run). The local-band outages REDUCE this over-run vs the prior keeper (run143 grid 160.42 -> 157.80 TWh). ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md, docs/audit-followup-tests-2026-06.md).
Same nodal-congestion residual as 2024; not zonal-LP closable. ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md).

Gas-steam availability the energy-only LP cannot reach: ST_GAS carries committed/AS-held capacity (the CPS steamers, Cedar Bayou) whose out-of-merit operation has no forward-defensible LP path. The local band IMPROVES ST_GAS toward bench vs the prior keeper (run143 grid 10.46 -> 12.30 TWh). ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md).

Same committed/AS-held gas-steam structural wedge; the CC nodal over-run also displaces ST_GAS in the zonal merit order. Local band improves ST_GAS toward bench vs run143 (grid 9.33 -> 11.38 TWh). ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md).
Same gas-steam structural wedge; improves toward bench vs run143 (grid 8.61 -> 9.95 TWh). ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md).

The documented cheap-gas year-gradient residual: in 2024 ($2.19 gas) the LP correctly idles loss-making self-committed/contracted PRB/lignite that ran 40-52% CF below marginal cost. The 2024 coal split is justified-lumpy and the multi-year PRB mean is centered (the run-90 gradient finding); vs EIA-930 grid the same coal sits +0.1pp. ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (docs/calibration-best-so-far.md, COAL_PRB carve-out).

2023 is structurally out-of-market: ~42% of 2023 dollars are out-of-market scarcity (RTORDPA/ECRS-conservative deployments, ERCOT 2023 reserve practice) an ORDC-only energy+reserve co-opt cannot reproduce (run140 decomposition). No outage or ORDC lever reaches it without fitting to the residual. ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION.

Driven by the same 2023 out-of-market scarcity gap (run140): the model reproduces the energy-and-reserve price formation but not the ~42% out-of-market component, thinning the summer tail. ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION.

Mild-tail under-capture: the energy-only co-opt fires the genuine summer scarcity (Aug max $5000) but under-counts the count of mild >$200 hours the actual market cleared via out-of-market reserve deployments. The local band firms the 2024 tail TOWARD actual (h>$200 22->33 vs actual 53; mean MAE 9.6->7.1) without re-inflating the shoulder VOLL over-fire. ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION.
